target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (p q : ℝ) (f g : α → ℝ), p.HolderConjugate q → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ f x) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ g x) → MeasureTheory.MemLp f (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ → MeasureTheory.MemLp g (ENNReal.ofReal q) μ → ∫ x, f x * g x ∂μ ≤ (∫ x, f x ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) * (∫ x, g x ^ q ∂μ) ^ (1 / q)
